name: techdella/callout
title: Callout
description: Article callout: a note, tip, warning or key point, with an optional title. Text takes **bold**, *italic*, [links](url) and "- " lists.

attributes.title: Start with the questions buyers ask
attributes.text: List 15–20 real questions from sales calls before you write a single page. They become your headings, FAQs and briefs.

techdella.help: variant: note (canvas), tip (sand), warning (outlined) or key (dark, one per article). Keep it to 1–3 sentences or a short list.
